overall_notes: The paper presents CTRLEval, an unsupervised reference-free metric for evaluating controlled text generation. It evaluates generated texts from models like CTRL, PPLM, GeDi, and CoCon on sentiment-controlled and topic-controlled generation tasks. The method uses pre-trained language models (PEGASUS, BART, T5) as evaluators through text infilling tasks. Human evaluation was conducted via Amazon Mechanical Turk with clear quality control measures. The extraction was generally good but needed some normalization and removal of evaluator models from the generation models list.
